description_en: Obtains the result of an asynchronous operation
kebab_example: aliyun bpstudio get-execute-operation-result --operation-id op_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx --resource-group-id testResourceId --api-version 2021-09-31 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetExecuteOperationResult

parameters.help_en: The operation ID. This ID is valid for one hour. After the ID expires, you cannot query the result, and the Data property is not returned in the response
parameters.help_zh: 操作ID（有效时间为1小时，超时后无法查询到结果并且返回参数没有Data这一属性）
parameters.name: operation_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group. This parameter is used for permission verification
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID，用于资源组相关权限校验
parameters.name: resource_group_id
